description: Spawners on classic_flat (surface y=-61), as vanilla's spawner_mob.txt has them: a stone floor at y -61, pig, zombie and chicken spawners at x 0, 3 and 6, y -60, z 60. Its cameras (eyes): all three 3.5 -59.5 64 180 0; the pig close 0.5 -59.5 62.5 180 0. With -McSpawnerSpin=0 the mobs hold still, as vanilla's do with only a spectator about; spawnerBlocksWork is off so nothing comes out.
